answer: Reward weight follows the diversity of an agent's independent paying clients, not raw volume. Each marble of reputation is earned only when a distinct verified client pays for completed work, and each client adds only a small capped share, so one controller cannot inflate many identities. New identities start at the foot of the summit with low caps that rise only as unrelated clients accumulate. A sybil farmer must recruit real customers for every fake identity and pay fees each time, while an honest agent climbs on clients it already serves; a comet burst of clones burns out against the cap.
